__comment: Chemical-class corrections (2026-07-23) for scripts/convex/set-chemical-class.mjs. GHB is 4-hydroxybutyric acid, not a gabapentinoid (no alpha2delta ligand activity); tags follow baclofen ('Butyric acid') and phenibut ('GABA analogue'). bk-2C-B lacks the alpha-methyl that defines cathinones; it is a beta-keto phenethylamine (2C-B derivative).
